## Overview

- **Dates:** August 24–26, 2026
- **Venue:** Kavli IPMU, The University of Tokyo
- **Organizers:**
  - Kantaro Ohmori (RIKEN)
  - Shuhei Ohyama (RIKEN)
  - Mayuko Yamashita (RIKEN)
  - Yuji Tachikawa (Kavli IPMU)

## Program

Three-day lecture series by [Bowen Yang](https://yangbowenmath.github.io/yangbowenmath/index.html), based on [arXiv:2602.16572](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16572) (joint work with Mattie Ji), in which quantum cellular automata are classified by an algebraic K-theory spectrum.

**Title:** TBD

| Date            | Time          |
|-----------------|---------------|
| Mon, August 24  | 15:30 – 17:00 |
| Tue, August 25  | 15:30 – 17:00 |
| Wed, August 26  | 15:30 – 17:00 |
